title: The Garden After Rain (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate garden family seasons soft
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
After the rain the garden has a different voice
The smell of wet earth tells you that you had no choice
But to come outside and stand in it a moment before going back in
The garden after rain is where the proper day begins

[Pre-Chorus]
I've been coming to this garden since the children were small
They've all grown up and gone but the garden takes them all

[Chorus]
The garden after rain is where I'm most myself
Everything washed clean and put back on the shelf
The garden after rain is telling me it's fine
The roots are deeper than the weather — that's the sign
The gardens still growing

[Verse 2]
The roses hold the drops on the outer edge of every leaf
The soil is dark and open and has come to some relief
The birds arrive when rain has stopped — they know there's work to do
The garden after rain is doing what a garden's meant to do

[Bridge]
I could go inside and have a cup of tea instead
I often do eventually and that's probably what's ahead
But for this moment I am standing in the garden after rain
Knowing that the garden will be here for this again

[Outro]
After the rain the garden knows… the garden always knows…
The gardens still growing
